_spec: Registry of tool / MCP-server adapters loadable by scripts.tool_adapter.load_adapters(). New external tools are onboarded by adding a DATA entry here, not by writing new invocation code. Unknown/malformed entries are skipped and reported to stderr (drift-tolerant), never crash. See scripts/tool_adapter.py for the adapter interface and scripts/tool_groups.py + scripts/freshness_lib.py for the connector-id naming convention (lower_snake_case, matches CONNECTOR_DEFAULTS keys where the same external system is also freshness-tracked).
